name: image_gen
description: Image V3: brief → thesis → composition → material → lighting → bitmap. Not a pretty-picture button. No baked titles unless asked.
when_to_use: Hero/atmosphere bitmaps, product plates, vector accents/marks, or stylized lettering
prompt_negative: Do not generate a pretty picture without thesis/composition/material/lighting. Do not bake titles into the image unless the user explicitly wants text in the picture. If the user forbids image gen, skip bitmap heroes.

zh-CN.description: 图像 V3：简报→论点→构图→材质→光→图。不是出一张好看的图。禁止烘焙标题（除非用户要求图内文字）。

en.description: Image V3: brief → thesis → composition → material → lighting → image. No baked titles unless asked.
